# CurlCustomGetRetainsPostBody

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="info" text="off by default" />

Group: [Probable bugs](/rules/#probable-bugs)

A custom GET method does not clear an already configured request body. Remove the body when switching to a bodyless GET request. This inspection is disabled by default because the intended policy or use can vary.

## Example

```php{2,3}
<?php
$h=curl_init();curl_setopt($h,CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS,"x=1");curl_setopt($h,CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST,"GET");curl_exec($h);
$g=curl_init();curl_setopt($g,CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS,["x"=>1]);curl_setopt($g,CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST,"GET");curl_exec($g);
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 2: Clear the request body before switching to GET.</li>
<li>line 3: Clear the request body before switching to GET.</li>
</ul>

## Detection

- D1. Same curl handle configures nonempty CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS followed by CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST GET and executes without clearing body. Require straight-line final state; report opt-in because GET bodies can be intentional.
- D1e. Exclude later CURLOPT_HTTPGET, CURLOPT_POST, CURLOPT_UPLOAD or CURLOPT_NOBODY setters between the body/custom-GET setup and execution; they can change the underlying transfer mode and invalidate the retained-body proof.
- D2. Resolve builtin functions, classes, constants and methods; user-defined lookalikes are excluded. Follow only bounded local proof in one lexical scope.
- D3. Emit one finding per violating operation, not per supporting evidence statement. Use existing analysis budgets; exhausted proof produces no report.

## Exceptions (no report)

- E1. Do not report unresolved or shadowed builtin names, unknown values, or incomplete receiver/type provenance. Unknown calls, aliases escaping, and intervening writes invalidate local proof. Similar code outside the stated detection contract is not a finding.
- E2. Both standard suppression forms suppress this native ID.

## Fix

None. Choosing a repair requires intent or additional runtime information.

## PHP versions

Available throughout supported PHP 5.3–8.5 where the referenced builtin/extension is available. Respect syntax/version-specific receiver contracts; unavailable APIs are not this rule’s concern.

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "CurlCustomGetRetainsPostBody": {
      "enabled": true
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file):

```php
// @custos-ignore CurlCustomGetRetainsPostBody
```
